description: VN 'giải thích cho tôi' transfer: learners drop the dative 'to' ('explain me this'). Rule en-vietlish-explain-to-me inserts 'to' between a form of explain and a directly-governed pronoun object (me/him/her/us/them/you). Inserting 'to' is always grammatical, so this is a safe insertion.
fp_risk_note: Low risk. Inserting the dative 'to' after explain + a pronoun object is always grammatical. V1 fires only when a form of explain directly governs a pronoun object. Negatives lock: already-correct 'explain to me', non-pronoun objects ('explain the rule', 'the plan'), and an already-correct 'explained it to her'.

positive.notes: Base 'explain' + pronoun 'me' + determiner NP -> canonical dative order: explain <NP> to me.

positive.expectedCorrection: Can you explain to me how?
positive.notes: Insert 'to'; engine also adds the terminal question mark (en-question-form-final-mark).

positive.expectedCorrection: He explained the rule to me.
positive.notes: Past 'explained' + pronoun 'me' + determiner NP -> canonical dative order: explained <NP> to me.

negative.notes: Already correct ('to' present) -> must abstain (capitalization-only is not a rule firing).
Non-pronoun object 'the rule' -> must not fire.
Object 'it' separates explain from the pronoun; already correct -> must abstain.
Non-pronoun object 'the plan' -> must not fire.
